title: 第398章 北线药庄第397章 天都的假消息
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
白松林位于石峡最深处。
从外面看，林中只有一座废弃采药棚，棚后便是陡峭石壁。
韩立留下的无形刀印贴在石壁下方，标出了南门外阵的位置。
午时前半个时辰，青篷车沿山路驶来。
朱有福负责赶车。
六名女暗卫躺在车厢里，手脚都绑着从驿站带回的软索。
枯荣替她们改了血气，又在眉心涂上同样的褐色药膏。
若只用普通鉴体法器粗看，她们与账册上的六名女子不会有太大区别。
真正的七名受害者已经被秘密送到城主府药院。
韩立藏在车底原来的位置。
这次随他一起进庄的，还有林莹的一枚阵盘。
阵盘不用于攻击，只记录车经过的每一道阵纹。
只要转移阵启动过，林莹便能从外面找到阵力流向。
林天没有进入药车。
他与李清雪、枯荣停在白松林西侧，隔着外阵观察。
赵灵儿的人封住了石峡外围三条山路，却没有靠近药庄，以免被庄内神识发现。
林墨负责东门药材路。
两名皇室暗卫守北侧转移阵。
朱有福把青七药牌，挂上车辕，按照魂牌回信。
“在午时前驶到采药棚。”

此时，棚内坐着一个正在晒药的老妇。
她没有抬头，只问：“哪条线？”
“青七。”
“几份？”
“六份，途中折一。”
老妇把一把白松针撒到车前。
松针落地以后没有散开，而是沿着看不见的阵纹排成一条弯曲小路。
朱有福驱车顺着小路前进，眼前石壁像水面一样向两侧分开。
真正的北庄藏在石壁后。
里面没有高楼，只有六座相连石院。
院墙压得很低，屋顶全部铺着灰瓦，远远看去像一片普通药农住处。
“不对，”
“每一座院子下方，都有阵力流动。”
朱有福没有四处张望。
商人第一次来陌生地方，越装镇定，越容易显得刻意。
他干脆盯着迎面走来的两名守卫，先开口抱怨。
content_en:
The white pine forest is located in the deepest part of the stone gorge.
From the outside, there is only an abandoned herb-gathering shed in the forest, and behind the shed is a steep rock wall.
The invisible sword mark left by Han Li was pasted on the bottom of the stone wall, marking the location of the South Gate's outer formation.
Half an hour before noon, a green-covered car drove along the mountain road.
Zhu Youfu is in charge of driving the car.
Six female secret guards were lying in the carriage, their hands and feet tied with soft ropes brought back from the inn.
Kurong changed their blood status and applied the same brown ointment on their eyebrows.
If you just use ordinary body identification instruments to look at them at a glance, there won't be much difference between them and the six women in the account book.
The real seven victims have been secretly sent to the City Lord's Mansion Pharmacy.
Han Li hid in his original position under the car.
This time, there was also a formation disk belonging to Lin Ying who accompanied him into the village.
The formation disk is not used for attacks, it only records every formation pattern the car passes through.
As long as the transfer array is activated, Lin Ying can find the direction of the array's power from the outside.
Lin Tian did not enter the medicine cart.
He, Li Qingxue and Kurong stopped on the west side of the white pine forest and observed from across the outer formation.
Zhao Ling'er's people blocked the three mountain roads outside Shixia, but did not approach the medicine village to avoid being discovered by the spiritual consciousness inside the village.
Lin Mo is in charge of Dongmen Medicinal Material Road.
Two royal secret guards guard the transfer formation on the north side.
Zhu Youfu hung the Qingqi medicine tablet on the shaft of the car and replied according to the soul tablet.
"Drive to the herb collection shed before noon."
At this time, there was an old woman sitting in the shed who was drying medicine.
She didn't look up and just asked: "Which line?"
"Qingqi."
"How many servings?"
"Six copies, fold one off on the way."
The old woman threw a handful of white pine needles in front of the car.
The pine needles did not scatter after falling to the ground, but formed a winding path along the invisible pattern.
Zhu Youfu drove along the path, and the stone walls in front of him separated to both sides like water.
The real Beizhuang is hidden behind the stone wall.
There are no tall buildings inside, only six connected stone courtyards.
The courtyard walls are very low, and the roofs are all covered with gray tiles. From a distance, it looks like an ordinary medicine farmer's residence.
"No,"
"Under every courtyard, there are formations flowing."
Zhu Youfu didn't look around.
When a businessman comes to a strange place for the first time, the calmer he pretends to be, the easier it is for him to appear deliberate.
He simply stared at the two guards approaching and complained first.
